LanguageData.MB_RadiusTip: Cells around the impact point that lose their rock and overhead mountain roof.
LanguageData.MB_DropResources: Drop ore and resources from erased rock
LanguageData.MB_DropResourcesTip: On: a mining tool. Off: everything is vaporised, a terraforming tool.
LanguageData.MB_ClearAllRoofs: Also remove built (non-mountain) roofs in the radius
LanguageData.MB_ClearAllRoofsTip: Off: only the natural mountain roof is removed.
LanguageData.MB_BlastDamage: Blast damage to pawns and buildings: {0}
LanguageData.MB_BlastDamageTip: 0 means the shot is harmless apart from erasing rock and roof.
LanguageData.MB_CellsPerTickTip: Lower values spread a large blast over more ticks to avoid a hitch.
